# Mnemosyne

> Local-first, long-term memory for AI agents. One SQLite file keeps what an agent learned together with the evidence it came from, and serves it to any host over TypeScript, MCP, CLI or authenticated HTTP. When a source is corrected, every memory that depended on it is retired, so the next agent starts from what is still true.

Package: `mnemosy-ai` on npm (prerelease channel `next` = 2.0.0-rc.10; `latest` = 1.0.1, the older engine). MIT licensed. Node.js >= 22.16. No API key, database server or Docker is needed for the local engine.

Install and connect:
- `npm install mnemosy-ai@2.0.0-rc.10`, then `npx --no-install mnemosy demo` runs an offline demonstration.
- MCP server for Claude Code (`.mcp.json`), Cursor (`.cursor/mcp.json`) or any MCP client: command `npx`, args `-y -p mnemosy-ai@2.0.0-rc.10 mnemosy mcp --db ./.mnemosyne/memory.sqlite --workspace <workspace> --agent <agent>`. Add `--read-only` to omit mutation tools. 17 tools named `memory_*`: store, recall, context, correct, checkpoint, resume, observe, inspect, source, skill, model, entity, traverse, jobs, forget, branch_preview, capture.
- TypeScript: `createLocalMemory` from `mnemosy-ai/local` (SQLite engine); `MemoryAgent` from `mnemosy-ai/agent`; `MemoryRuntime` from `mnemosy-ai/runtime`; `createMnemosyne` from `mnemosy-ai` (the service-backed vector engine).

Measured results (methods and caveats in the linked pages): LongMemEval-S answer accuracy 409 of 500 (81.8%, 95% CI 78.2-84.9) with reranked retrieval read by claude-sonnet-4.6 and judged by claude-haiku-4.5; LoCoMo reranker gain MRR@10 +0.163; matched run against Mem0 OSS with every loss published. Two release targets are not met and are disclosed: recall latency at one million records (p95 139-223 ms against a 50 ms goal) and contextual reranking (four questions short of its gate).

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/28naem-del/mnemosyne/blob/main/README.md): what it is, install, MCP config, measured results with limits, capability table.
- [Quickstart](https://github.com/28naem-del/mnemosyne/blob/main/docs/quickstart.md): run the demos, choose an engine, first integration.
- [Local API](https://github.com/28naem-del/mnemosyne/blob/main/docs/api.md): `createLocalMemory` store, recall, correct, compile, forget, scopes and trust.
- [Agent lifecycle](https://github.com/28naem-del/mnemosyne/blob/main/docs/AGENT.md): `MemoryAgent`, checkpoints, handoff and resume.
- [Context contract](https://github.com/28naem-del/mnemosyne/blob/main/docs/CONTEXT.md): budgeted context compilation, citations, uncertainty.
- [Runtime](https://github.com/28naem-del/mnemosyne/blob/main/docs/RUNTIME.md): jobs, skill trials, project models, HTTP service, inspector and Python client.
- [Local models](https://github.com/28naem-del/mnemosyne/blob/main/docs/LOCAL-MODELS.md): optional CPU embedder and reranker, hybrid recall, dense index modes.
- [Provider tools](https://github.com/28naem-del/mnemosyne/blob/main/docs/PROVIDER-TOOLS.md): the six virtual memory operations exposed as OpenAI Responses functions and Gemini function declarations, and as Claude's native memory tool.
- [Claude native memory commands](https://github.com/28naem-del/mnemosyne/blob/main/docs/ANTHROPIC-MEMORY.md): a client-side handler for Anthropic's native `memory_20250818` tool that stores its virtual files with revisions and provenance.
- [Gradual migration bridge](https://github.com/28naem-del/mnemosyne/blob/main/docs/BRIDGE.md): read-only adapter over a previous memory system with staged routing.
- [Import and export](https://github.com/28naem-del/mnemosyne/blob/main/docs/MIGRATION.md): eleven import profiles, preview, atomic apply, undo.
- [Version 2 migration](https://github.com/28naem-del/mnemosyne/blob/main/docs/MIGRATION-v2.md): changes from the 1.x `latest` line.
- [Operations](https://github.com/28naem-del/mnemosyne/blob/main/docs/OPERATIONS.md): whole-database backup, integrity verification and restore into a new path.
- [Deployment](https://github.com/28naem-del/mnemosyne/blob/main/docs/deployment.md): HTTP service, container, authentication.
- [Evaluation](https://github.com/28naem-del/mnemosyne/blob/main/docs/EVALUATION.md) and [Benchmarks](https://github.com/28naem-del/mnemosyne/blob/main/docs/evaluation/BENCHMARKS.md): protocols, raw reports, fingerprints.
- [Comparison with Mem0](https://github.com/28naem-del/mnemosyne/blob/main/COMPARISON.md): matched competitor run, losses included.
- [Changelog](https://github.com/28naem-del/mnemosyne/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): every change with its commit and every unmet gate.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/28naem-del/mnemosyne/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md): engines, storage, retrieval path.
- [Examples](https://github.com/28naem-del/mnemosyne/blob/main/examples/README.md): 15 runnable examples, offline fixtures marked.
